name: New line - Galaxy Z Flip8 $0 with trade-in - Extra 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: enthusiastic, exclamation marks.
scripted_messages: Hi!! I'm SO excited to finally switch to AT&T! I want a new line with the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 (the site says $0 a month with eligible trade-in!) and I'd trade in my Galaxy S24, it's paid off and looks brand new. I'm thinking Extra 2.0, what would my monthly total be? Just pricing today.
Amazing, thank you! Is the trade-in credit applied automatically or do I have to request it?
Perfect! And one small question, will the credits show up on my very first bill or later on?
That's awesome, thank you so much! You were so friendly and helpful.
Nope, that's everything! Have an amazing day, bye!!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 6: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 7: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
